messages:
maya (People Ops): Heads-up: offer pending for Staff SRE. Manager requests +15k above band cap and a 50/50 split sign-on. Need approval flow.
eddie (Recruiter): Candidate verbally accepted; target start 2026-04-27. Comp proposal: base 190k, band cap 175k, sign-on 30k split 15/15.
rachel (Hiring Manager): Critical hire for incident automation roadmap. Will draft manager justification now.
liza (Comp & Benefits): Anything >band needs Director sign-off and Finance review. Also require comparables and a proposed clawback schedule for split payments.
maya (People Ops): Process: attach justification -> Comp routes to Director -> Finance ticket opened by payroll-bot -> Legal reviews clawback -> People Ops issues offer. ETA depends on approvals.
eddie (Recruiter): Adding manager note: "reduces paging noise and on-call MTTR; will mentor two ICs." Attached peer comps.
payroll-bot: Created FIN-2026-319 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2026-319. Add approved amounts when final.
liza (Comp & Benefits): Routing to Director Marta. Provisional OK if manager justification and peers look comparable.
maya (People Ops): If Director approves, Legal needs 24h to finalize clawback language. Candidate update: "formal offer pending approvals; expect within 3 business days." 
eddie (Recruiter): Noted. I'll keep candidate warm and wait for offer PDF.
rachel (Hiring Manager): Thanks all. If Marta signs today we can close fast.
